integrity: Analytic proof gives all dimensions over the real or complex scalars; exact finite enumeration is supplementary and not a substitute for the proof. No independent audit or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Constructive lower bound only, not exact clique number. The uniform-support maximum does not optimize arbitrary vertices. Comparison against a relevant 2022 survey is abstract-only; unindexed equivalent constructions may exist.
title: Ternary-support cliques of order \(3^n/\sqrt n\) in the Birkhoff–James orthograph of \(\ell_\infty^n\)
